summary: Tube Archivist is a self-hosted application designed to help you download, organise, and watch your YouTube subscriptions and video collections locally. It indexes metadata to provide searchable access to your downloaded media through a web interface, while also tracking your viewing history.
goodFor: This tool suits users who want to maintain a local archive of online video content independent of the original platform and need an interface to browse it.
watchOut: Running a local video archiver requires substantial storage space, and performance depends on how efficiently metadata indexing scales with large collections.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent volumes for data storage and connect a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination for the web interface.
